correctness.rationale: For k even>=6 let h=v2(k)+2<k, q=2^h, 1<=t<q. The cyclic odd-unit structure and v2(5^k-1)=h establish that odd kth powers are exactly 1+qZ/2^a for a>h and 1 mod2^a when a<=h. The number r of odd summands is uniquely recorded mod q because r<=t<q, and the r>=1 branch fills an entire coset with one variable odd summand, while r=0 factors as 2^k times a smaller power-sum image. This gives an exact disjoint recurrence for each modulus, geometric 2-adic shell decomposition, Haar measure t/[q(1-2^-k)] and boundary {0}. The recurrence implies exact k-periodic bounded discrepancy in a; an independent brute-force set equality checker found agreement in 231 exact finite cases. The proofs cover arbitrary allowed k,t,a; finite checks do not replace it.
